title: On Serving supper to twenty guests
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：serve　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 serve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the observer ① served supper to twenty guests on the same day, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② serves supper to twenty guests before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ serve supper to twenty guests at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ served supper to twenty guests before — a line in the log for November 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Serving supper to twenty guests on the same day, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ serve in the north for three years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Serve in the north for three years at once and never mention it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ serves in the north for three years on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ served supper to twenty guests again when nobody else would.

⑩ To serve supper to twenty guests, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody serves supper to twenty guests before dawn again and somebody must serve supper to twenty guests on the same day all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 端上（一般过去式 served supper to twenty guests：1971 年观测员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 端上（一般现在 serves supper to twenty guests：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 端上（不定式 to serve supper to twenty guests：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 端上（过去完成时 had served supper to twenty guests：1965 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 端上（动名词 serving supper to twenty guests 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 服役（serve in the north for three years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去服役在北方服役三年）
G. v. 服役（serve in the north for three years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 端上（后段两处：新来的助手照例 serves in the north for three years，而母亲又一次 served supper to twenty guests）

serve 意为“端上”，结尾那句是母亲 1983 年的话：要端上给二十位客人端上晚饭，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 serve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the observer served supper to twenty guests on the same day, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer serves supper to twenty guests before dawn whenever the observatory asks.
Serving supper to twenty guests on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever serve in the north for three years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory serves in the north for three years on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother served supper to twenty guests again, and the observatory remembered that half.
